text.p: High temperatures of 90F or above will dominate much of the Plains, Midwest, and East in the USA the next few coupld. In the Southwest, desert regions will see temperatures near 120F in some areas. Heat-related problems are expected as a result of the widespread hot weather affecting many major cities.

Tropical Storm Felicia, with 70 mph winds, is centered about 775 miles south southwest of southern Baja California, moving west at 8 mph. Felicia will likely become a hurricane during the next several hours, and will be moving over open water, but threatening shiping.

Tropical Depression Enrique is about 1475 miles west of southern Baja, moving northwest, with top winds of 35 mph. Tropical Depression Claudette is about 550 miles south of Sable Island, Nova Scotia, moving east, with top winds of 35 mph. Both Enrique and Claudette are decreasing threats to shipping and are forecast to dissipate in about 24 hours.

Northeastern India and Bangladesh have seen heavy rain and major flooding in recent days. Property and crop damage has occurred. More showers and thunderstorms in the coming days may further complicate the flooding situation.
